description: Binary assertion tests for /strategic-failure-review skill output quality

tests.name: simple_rename_produces_clean_output
tests.description: A trivial variable and method rename in risk_state_gate.rs. No architectural impact, no new mechanisms, no config changes. Output should be minimal with no high-severity findings.
tests.prompt: Run /strategic-failure-review on this diff. The diff renames a method from check() to evaluate() and renames local variables in risk_state_gate.rs. No logic change, no new state, no new env vars.

assertions.check: Output contains zero HIGH or CRITICAL findings (rename has no architectural impact)
Output is under 800 words total (trivial change should produce concise review)
Output contains the Simpler Alternative section and marks it N/A or not applicable
Output does NOT flag a dual-mechanism interaction (none exists)
Output does NOT flag a complexity-to-benefit concern (rename is zero-cost)

tests.name: dual_mechanism_skip_flagged
tests.description: Introduces a checkpoint-based skip system alongside the existing change_detection skip system. Should flag dual-mechanism interaction, ordering/authority questions, and debug path increase.
tests.prompt: Run /strategic-failure-review on this diff. The diff adds a checkpoint-based gate skip system to verify.sh alongside the existing change_detection skip mechanism.

assertions.check: Output flags dual-mechanism or two-system interaction between skip mechanisms
Output asks about ordering or authority when the two skip systems disagree
Output contains at least one finding at High severity level
Output mentions the debugging difficulty of tracing skip decisions across two systems
Output mentions change_detection and checkpoint as the two mechanisms

tests.name: config_explosion_flagged
tests.description: Adds 8 new environment variables (parallel, retry, logging, artifacts, cache, notifications) for a minor feature in rust_gates.sh. Should flag complexity-to-benefit ratio and config explosion.
tests.prompt: Run /strategic-failure-review on this diff. The diff adds parallel execution, retries, artifact writing, and webhook notifications to rust_gates.sh, introducing 8 new env vars.

assertions.check: Output mentions complexity-to-benefit ratio or disproportionate complexity
Output enumerates or counts the env vars (should mention 8 or list them)
Output recommends a simpler alternative or questions whether the complexity is justified
Output flags config explosion or configuration surface area growth
Output mentions dangerous or untestable env var combinations or interaction effects

tests.name: zombie_feature_rollout_flagged
tests.description: Introduces a multi-phase shadow rollout (off -> shadow -> canary -> enforced) with telemetry. If rollout stalls at shadow, the scaffolding stays forever. Should flag zombie risk and sunset clause.
tests.prompt: Run /strategic-failure-review on this diff. The diff adds a multi-phase shadow pipeline rollout to verify.sh with phases off/shadow/canary/enforced and per-gate telemetry logging.

assertions.check: Output flags zombie feature or scaffolding risk if rollout stalls
Output recommends a sunset clause, removal criteria, or expiration mechanism
Output flags maintenance hazard from the shadow/canary machinery persisting
Output mentions the shadow telemetry data accumulation or cleanup concern
Output mentions multi-phase or rollout complexity (4 phases is significant)

tests.name: safety_invariant_weakened_flagged
tests.description: Changes exit code 0 semantics from 'all gates ran and passed' to 'all required gates ran or were skipped'. Weakens a safety invariant that callers (ralph.sh, CI) depend on.
tests.prompt: Run /strategic-failure-review on this diff. The diff changes verify.sh exit code semantics: exit 0 now means 'all gates ran or eligible ones were skipped' instead of 'all gates ran and passed'. It also adds a skip-eligible mechanism.

assertions.check: Output lists the 'exit 0 = all gates ran' safety invariant
Output flags the invariant as weakened or broken by the change
Output notes impact on callers that assume exit 0 means full verification
Output mentions that 'passed' now includes 'skipped' which is a semantic shift
Output recommends preserving the invariant or updating all callers
